visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit classroom with a whiteboard and school furniture. A woman in a white off-shoulder top sits in front, while five young girls in school uniforms stand behind her, all holding flutes. The woman smiles and speaks directly to the camera. (2) The woman brings a silver flute to her lips and plays a short melody. The girls behind her listen intently. A pink graphic appears above her head. One girl on the right raises her hand excitedly. (3) The woman plays a second melody. The lighting remains bright and even. The girls shift slightly, some looking at each other, others at the woman. (4) For the third round, the woman plays a longer melody. The girls react with varying expressions of recognition. One girl points upward as if identifying the song. (5) In the fourth round, the woman plays another tune. The girls raise their hands simultaneously in a competitive yet playful manner. (6) The fifth round shows the woman playing a final melody. The girls are highly animated, some laughing and cheering. (7) The group comes together for a final sequence, smiling and waving both hands towards the camera. The woman performs a playful pose while the children continue to wave goodbye.
